transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (627x765) SnowPro-style form (older layout, no branding) -> source_format 'other'. DATE CONFLICT: printed date 17/11/2002 (day > 12) vs file name 'tak020110' and the printed No. 'TA020110' (2002-01-10); printed date recorded, record_id unchanged. Height axis 2.374 px/cm (0 cm y700); boundaries from H-column lines/bar edges 144/134/124/120/110/109/66/45/12/9/0 (+-1 cm). Two dashed table rows; the second maps to the 144-134 cm layer (10 table rows for 10 bars). Hardness: bar widths on the non-linear axis agree with the R-column icons. Sizes printed with an italic '5' glyph are ambiguous (leading-dot value vs literal 5) and are not decoded (null + uncertain, literal in comment). The caret-with-crossed-top glyph (also in the 2002-03-06 Takakkaw chart) is unmapped. Temperatures: circles on 23.8 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F gridline x267); the circle where the vertical dashed air line (-4.1 = printed air temp) meets the surface is not recorded; the 20 cm circle lies inside the hatched bar (+-0.2 C).
